answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 1223 Country: India Title: I desire my childern to become Alim.Presently they are studying in an english medium school where for boys Hifz -e -Quran course is provided and for girls dineyat is tought. Where can I enroll my daughters for Alim course.Is it allowed to keep girls in hostels. Allah Hafiz Question: As Salam Alikum Mufit Sahab I desire my childern to become Alim.Presently they are studying in an english medium school where for boys Hifz -e -Quran course is provided and for girls dineyat is tought. Where can I enroll my daughters for Alim course.Is it allowed to keep girls in hostels. Allah Hafiz Answer ID: 1223 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 828/781=B) If you really like to get your children Alims then you should send them in any good madrasa. The Hifz and Islamic education can not be acquired with continuing English medium school education. If you are interested you should get your daughters admitted in any good girl madrasa which has a satisfactory Islamic education system. You should look for such madrasas yourself. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
